description:
One run in full from the athlete's Goblin Gains records: distance, time,
    pace, average and max HR, time in each HR zone, every lap (split) with
    its pace and HR, and the session's RPE. Every run of `day`, else of the
    newest day with a run. Needs the athlete's key.

day.description: The run's day, YYYY-MM-DD; omitted for the newest run. Example: "2026-11-26".
day.title: Day
